inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Patient who completed surgery for his breast cancer and for which definitive histo-pathological analysis of surgical specimen is available.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Patient who completed surgery for his breast cancer and for which definitive histo-pathological analysis of surgical specimen is available.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Invasive breast carcinoma pN0 or pN(i+) with histological tumor size ≤ 10 mm (pT1a/b subgroup).
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Invasive breast carcinoma pN0 or pN(i+) with histological tumor size ≤ 10 mm (pT1a/b subgroup).

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Invasive breast carcinoma with histological tumor size > 10 mm and ≤ 30 mm (pT1c T2 ≤ 30 mm control group).
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Invasive breast carcinoma with histological tumor size > 10 mm and ≤ 30 mm (pT1c T2 ≤ 30 mm control group).

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Patient with HER2-negative breast carcinoma: immuno-histochemistry (IHC) score = 0, 1+ or 2+ and in situ hybridization (FISH, CISH, or SISH) negative (local laboratory testing).
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Patient with HER2-negative breast carcinoma: immuno-histochemistry (IHC) score = 0, 1+ or 2+ and in situ hybridization (FISH, CISH, or SISH) negative (local laboratory testing).

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Patient with ER and PR negative invasive carcinoma (< 1% stained cells by immuno-histochemistry assay) (local laboratory testing).
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Patient with ER and PR negative invasive carcinoma (< 1% stained cells by immuno-histochemistry assay) (local laboratory testing).

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: In case of multifocality, the histological size of the largest tumor must be ≤ 10 mm or ≤ 30 mm according to the inclusion subgroup.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: In case of multifocality, the histological size of the largest tumor must be ≤ 10 mm or ≤ 30 mm according to the inclusion subgroup.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: In case of multifocality, all lesions must be ER, PR and HER2-negative.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: In case of multifocality, all lesions must be ER, PR and HER2-negative.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: In case of breast conserving surgery, clear margins are required.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: In case of breast conserving surgery, clear margins are required.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Patient affiliated to a Social Health Insurance in France.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Patient affiliated to a Social Health Insurance in France.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Patient information and written informed consent form signed prior to any study specific procedures.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Patient information and written informed consent form signed prior to any study specific procedures.

exclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Patients with any previous malignancy of the breast or other site, with the exception of adequately treated basal or squamous cell carcinoma, non-melanomatous skin cancer totally resected.
exclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Patients with any previous malignancy of the breast or other site, with the exception of adequately treated basal or squamous cell carcinoma, non-melanomatous skin cancer totally resected.

exclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Non-invasive breast carcinoma (i.e. ductal carcinoma in situ exclusively).
exclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Non-invasive breast carcinoma (i.e. ductal carcinoma in situ exclusively).

exclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Patients who received neo-adjuvant treatment (radiotherapy or chemotherapy or other before surgery).
exclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Patients who received neo-adjuvant treatment (radiotherapy or chemotherapy or other before surgery).

exclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Any psychological, familial, geographic or social situation, according to the judgment of investigator, potentially preventing the provision of informed consent or compliance to study procedure.
exclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Any psychological, familial, geographic or social situation, according to the judgment of investigator, potentially preventing the provision of informed consent or compliance to study procedure.

exclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Patient who has forfeited his/her freedom by administrative or legal award or who is under guardianship.
exclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Patient who has forfeited his/her freedom by administrative or legal award or who is under guardianship.
